d: Pakistan A registered a 48-run victory over India A after posting a competitive total of 313. Hasan Nawaz led the batting effort with 79 runs, supported by Maaz Sadaqat and Farhan Yousaf. In response, Abhishek Sharma scored a quickfire 70, while captain Tilak Varma struck a fighting century. However, India A fell short at 265 despite their efforts, handing Pakistan A a memorable victory.
